vision: Start a security-first semi-autonomous multiplayer AI organization through one reviewed Architectonic plan, with Workframe as the shared UI/workspace/supervision surface and Hermes as the first replaceable runtime adapter.

authority.stack_operator: operates one installation and release surface; does not inherit workspace or secret-retrieval authority
authority.workspace_role: resolved in the target workspace for every workspace-owned resource
authority.user_proxy: private runtime, capability, memory, payer, and session context bound to one user and one shared workspace agent identity
authority.credential: raw upstream secret is non-retrievable through normal product APIs; runtimes receive opaque revocable capabilities
authority.apply: discovery and planning are read-only; writes, deployment, adoption, and destructive operations require explicit immutable plan authority

history.note: The detailed item-by-item development rail, evidence, obsolete version campaigns, and deferred runtime-adapter rows remain immutable in Git history. This file is the smaller active release authority.

completed_baseline.evidence_location: Git history at history.previous_main_commit and the retained specs, release-evidence fixtures, package/install harness, CLI campaign files, and merged pull requests.
capabilities: version, package, docs-claim, UI, updater, release-evidence, and negative-install gates
empty-target install authority, mutation-free doctor, run authority, supervisor denial tests, and public-deploy preflight
real multiplayer workspace, room, message, file, invite, activity, credential, budget, grant, and agent surfaces
Hermes-native profile/runtime provisioning and user-proxy cohort behavior
standalone CLI Socratic begin, inference, constitutional draft, Architectonic plan/apply handoff, Workframe deployment plan, and immutable apply boundaries
create-workframe 0.1.64 and standalone workframe CLI 0.2.2 source/package truth
limitations: Historical completion means the named bounded contract passed; it does not imply public multi-user beta readiness.
Electron, second runtime adapter, and generative in-app UI remain unshipped product work.
The four target cells have not yet passed one immutable beta artifact matrix.

items.title: Remove legacy public mutations and bind every scoped request to its target workspace
acceptance: Stack role and target-workspace role are separate.
Workspace, room, memory, agent-credential, and invite paths resolve target scope before handler execution.
Owner of A receives only their actual role in B.
Invite access is bound to authenticated email and expiry.
Legacy auth bootstrap is denied in secure mode and setup is install-window plus stack-owner only.
Two-workspace adversarial matrix runs in the normal harness.
evidence: GitHub Actions CI run 30773814922: every version/docs/UI/updater/harness/package/negative-install step green.

items.title: Make credential use capability-based, non-retrievable, atomic, and revocable
items.stop_line: No public multi-user beta claim until replacement, removal, restore, and expiry revocation fixtures pass.

items.title: Persist runtime ownership, endpoints, secrets, and idempotent mutation identity
items.stop_line: No public multi-user runtime cleanup or automatic mutative retry until ownership and idempotency are durable.

items.title: Bound HTTP input and distinguish failures from valid empty state
evidence: services/workframe-api/request_body.py owns bounded strict body and pagination parsing.
POST/PATCH/DELETE and internal proxy/record paths reject malformed or oversized bodies before dispatch.
Room members/messages and workspace invite/memory/budget/grant failures return database_unavailable rather than empty success.
test_request_body.py, test_truthful_failures.py, test_resource_scope.py, and test_route_registry.py pass.
items.stop_line: No production-ready API claim while malformed input or backend failure can masquerade as valid empty state.

items.title: Make one immutable installation manifest the updater source of truth
items.stop_line: Do not freeze beta while running component identity can disagree with the package pin.

items.title: Scope Hermes profile operations and revoke long-lived room access
items.stop_line: No external multiplayer beta until profile and stream authority survives two-workspace and revocation matrices.

items.title: Freeze and prove one immutable baseline across all four Workframe instances
items.blocked_reason: Requires deployment credentials, target-cell access, invited test identities, backup/restore exercise, and one exact packed artifact on all four cells.

items.title: Unify CLI, Electron, Architectonic bootstrap, runtime adapters, and generative organization UI
delivery_order: cloud/local/Electron consumption of the same plan
Hermes profile and Architectonic archetype/skill manifests
one second runtime adapter after the Hermes contract is stable
items.stop_line: Do not market Electron, future adapters, or generative UI as shipped before bounded end-to-end acceptance.

items.title: External multi-user beta promotion
acceptance: One immutable source/package/config baseline passes every target cell.
Cross-workspace, raw-key, runtime-ownership, malformed-input, restore, and revocation matrices are green.
Owner and invited-member login, user-user and user-agent DM, Space mention, files, provider use, restart, backup, restore, doctor, and public preflight pass.
Known product limitations are explicit and the operator approves the named artifact for beta.
items.stop_line: No external invitation or production-ready claim before explicit operator promotion.
